honest_harness_note: The first attempt had a SQL fixture cast error (42804). It was fixed in the test before the recorded production red; this setup error is not claimed as a regression.
limitations: This is a bounded SQL read adapter check, not concurrent HTTP throughput or maximum-owner scalability measurement.
Owner candidate scans still scale with the number of authorized owners; the invariant bounds costly line hydration to the final page.
